label: 侧卧肘撑
pose_lead: Grounded pose, side-lying on one elbow:
lower_limbs: The legs lie stacked sideways and bent, extending as a whole toward frame right.
upper_limbs: The frame-left forearm props on the ground while the other hand reaches back along the body toward a leg or ankle.
torso_head: The upper body is raised on that forearm, the shoulder line tilted; the head leans slightly toward the supporting side.
weight_silhouette: Weight concentrates on the side hip, the outside of the legs and the forearm; the body forms a low, horizontally stretched silhouette.
